Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

ContextSourceRegistrationSpec.description: Desired specification of a `ContextSourceRegistration` resource (MF-36, SP-09).

contextSpaceRef.description: The Context Space whose broker learns of the source. The registration is written into this space's tenant and no other (SP-08, SP-09).

endpoint.description: A source elsewhere, as the base URL of its NGSI-LD API. Mutually exclusive with `endpointRef`.

endpointRef.description: A source on this platform, as an `Endpoint`. Mutually exclusive with `endpoint`.

expiresAt.description: When the registration stops being used, if it is not open-ended.

federation.description: Who this platform is when it forwards (PF-48).

information.description: What the source is claimed to hold, in CIM 009's own `information` shape: this is what the broker matches a query against, so it is the specification's member and not a shape of ours.

mode.description: How the source's answer relates to the broker's own data.

operations.description: Which operations the source is registered for, as CIM 009 clause 5.2.9 names them: an operation (`retrieveEntity`) or one of its groups (`federationOps`). Left out means the specification's own default, which is why this is not an enum here: the vocabulary is the broker's and a list of ours would go stale the first time CIM 009 adds a member.

schedule.description: How often the source's schema surface is mirrored; 24 hours when absent (DM-49).

EntitySelector.description: Entity type and id/pattern selector within a policy grant (R6).

idPattern.description: Anchored regular expression matching target entity URNs (R24, R33).

type.description: Target entity type short name in PascalCase.

Federation.description: Who this platform is when it forwards to the source (PF-48).

serviceAccountRef.description: The `ServiceAccount` the hub forwards as, required in `serviceAccount` mode.

FederationIdentity.description:
Which identity a forwarded request carries (PF-48).

Neither mode is a grant. `ServiceAccount` reads a source with the grants a `Policy` on that source gave the named account; `Caller` reads it with the caller's own. In both, the hub Endpoint's policy set applies as well and the narrower one wins.

oneOf.description: The hub forwards as a `ServiceAccount` of its own, named by `serviceAccountRef`.
The caller's own token is forwarded, rewritten for the source's audience.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

anyOf.description: Typed reference with kind, name, and optional namespace.

Ref.description: Reference to another resource, either bare name or typed reference (MF-07).

RegistrationInfo.description: Specification of target entity types, properties, and relationships (R6).

propertyNames.description: Whitelist of readable or writable property names (R6, R9).

relationshipNames.description: Whitelist of readable or writable relationship names (R6, R9).

RegistrationMode.description: How the broker treats a source's answer relative to its own data (CIM 009 clause 5.2.9).

oneOf.description: The source is one of several answers and the broker merges it with the rest.
The source is the only answer for what it covers.
The source answers alongside the broker's own data without overriding it.
The caller is redirected to the source rather than the broker forwarding.

Schedule.description:
How often a [`SyncSourceSpec`] runs (MF-28): `{ interval: 30m }` or `{ webhook: true }`.

Exactly one of the two members is set, for the same reason as [`SyncOrigin`].

webhook.description: Driven by a webhook from the source instead of a timer; only `true` is a schedule.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

namespace.description: Target resource namespace (defaults to caller namespace if omitted).

Urn.description: NGSI-LD entity URN conforming to ADR 001 / PF-42: urn:ngsi-ld:{Type}:{orgDomain}:{space}:{localId}

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
